text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished the race, Vivlos seemed to 
be overflowing with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, how should I put it! It's like, 
somehow—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Looking good♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm done running, I'm not even 
that out of breath! I feel like I've 
gotten stronger!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Trainie? What do you 
think!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Then it really is true!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah, the current me... will be fine.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Wait for me, Onee-chan...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I will, surely――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"We're definitely gonna win the Shuka Sho! 
Yeah!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll go get changed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Shuka Sho... Even along this Tiara 
route, it's bound to be a crucial race for 
her.
choice_data_list: (I want to be there to support her)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surely I cannot be the only one thinking 
this way. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Brr, cold. It's completely autumn now, 
huh."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...The 'Shuka Sho' is almost here, huh."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: If it's Vivlos, I'm sure she'll...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...This is no time to be resting. Even 
I...—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Cheval...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Do your best, both of you. As long as 
you have strong feelings... a path will 
open.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—May all my little sisters' dreams come 
true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little further... until the final 
crown, the Shuka Sho."
